effect.name: Composite Video (Background) [Type 5; NTSC]
effect.description: The shader creates realistic Composite Video (NTSC) effect.
effect.author: Foxioo

parameter.name: /* Foxioo Composite Video (Background) [Type 5; NTSC] Shader | 2026.08.20 */
parameter.description: The shader creates realistic Composite Video (PNTSCAL) effect.

parameter.name: Mixing
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for the visibility of the effect.

parameter.name: Time
parameter.description: This variable specifies the noise animation timer.

parameter.name: Cross Luma
parameter.description: The variable responsible for the visibility of luminance artifacts.

parameter.name: Cross Color / Rainbowing
parameter.description: The variable that controls the visibility of color artifacts.

parameter.name: Distortion
parameter.description: (EPILEPSY WARNING) This variable serves as a scale for distorting the final result; setting it to 0 disables the effect, while values slightly above zero (1e8, 1e7, 1e6) make the effect visible.

parameter.name: Size
parameter.description: This variable specifies the "blur" size in pixels

parameter.name: Quality
parameter.description: This variable determines the quality; the higher the value, the more work the GPU does.
